newsitem.title: USA: Enron, Portland end Wednesday talks.
newsitem.headline: Enron, Portland end Wednesday talks.

text.p: Settlement talks in the merger proceedings between Enron Corp, Portland General Corp and the Oregon Public Utility Commission ended Wednesday without a settlement, Portland General said late Wednesday.
Portland said the commission rejected Enron's offer of $61 million in price cuts for Portland General customers and did not modify its prior proposal, which Portland said was for $141 million.
Portland said Enron discussed additional cuts but that the commission believed the amounts were insufficient to reach a settlement Wednesday.
Portland said the companies expect to finalize a revised schedule by the end of the week.
Enron has requested that the schedule include a pre-hearing conference to permit subsequent public hearings on factual issues that may arise from the commission's final proposal, Portland said.
